# FreeJ2ME Web source snapshot

Origin: https://github.com/zb3/freej2me-web

Pinned commit: `c19416e75cbc15f9a27f7e967ee81cb108761e30`.

The original source tree and web runtime are retained for source availability and licensing. `web/init.zip` was excluded to avoid bundling third-party demo MIDlets. Git metadata is checkout-local under `.cache/`, not part of this snapshot. Integration changes are reproducible in `scripts/prepare-engine.mjs`; Java additions are separate in `java/`. The upstream runtime JAR is unmodified.
